lessons.feedback: Measurement permissions must never gate publishing; one platform's credential problem must never stop the others.
lessons.fix: Publishing requires only instagram_basic + instagram_content_publish (valid, unexpired, resolvable account). Missing insights scopes log 'Instagram metrics DEGRADED' and only disable IG metrics. In publish preflight an Instagram problem is a warning + alert + retryable ledger credential block + INSTAGRAM_CREDENTIAL_BLOCK (IG skipped like the owner pause); other platforms continue. Token health fails only on a real publishing problem. META_INSTAGRAM_REQUIRED=true keeps it fatal for the IG-only one-off job.

lessons.feedback: Measurement permissions must never gate publishing; one platform's credential problem must never stop the others.
lessons.fix: Publishing requires only instagram_basic + instagram_content_publish (valid, unexpired, resolvable account). Token health fails only on a real publishing problem. META_INSTAGRAM_REQUIRED=true keeps it fatal for the IG-only one-off job.
